purpose: Compact battle-significant technical delta index; reference studies remain authoritative evidence/calculation sources.

entries.valid_from: platform/weapon maturity dependent; 1941-42 carrier attack use requires aircraft-specific audit
entries.what_changed: Technical error and reproducibility of aerial torpedo attack and moving-ship dive bombing improve under equivalent conditions.

magnitude.note: Not percentage points; source calls these pre-additional-audit center estimates.

combat_meaning: Can reduce aircraft needed to reach a target damage/mission-kill probability threshold.
Freed aircraft can be reassigned to second targets, reserve waves, search, or CAP.

entries.valid_from: late 1930s-1941 first-line units after calibration/training maturation
entries.what_changed: Ship/launcher/gyro/lot calibration and fire-control error are reduced; same-opportunity practical torpedo effectiveness rises most at useful non-extreme ranges.

magnitude.range: overall same-condition practical hit rate +10% to +25% relative; later refined sensitivity often +5% to +12% at 5-12 km unalerted and smaller when targets maneuver

combat_meaning: More useful torpedoes per firing opportunity; does not make long-range shots precision attacks.

entries.valid_from: 1939-41 doctrine integration for equipped first-line destroyer/cruiser units
entries.what_changed: Reliability engineering cuts the long failure tail of reload machinery; reload becomes tactically schedulable in suitable engagements.

magnitude.range: 4-torpedo reload typically 6-9 min class; first launch to second effective firing solution/relaunch 12-20 min class

combat_meaning: In 20-60 minute night actions, next torpedoes can become actual combat power instead of paper ammunition.
Can force prolonged enemy evasive maneuver even when a second salvo is not ultimately fired.

entries.valid_from: class-specific; strongest in full-computation generations by opening/early war
entries.what_changed: Conventional submarines improve in range, trim/potential dive repeatability, battery use, machinery reliability, navigation, and sister-ship variance more than in headline speed.

magnitude.range: typical mature class effects include surface range +8-9%, submerged endurance +7-10%, dive time -10-15%, initial machinery faults -20-35%, sister-ship variance -30-50%; exact class values differ

combat_meaning: More boats leave on time, arrive on station, stay useful, survive mission degradation, and return to patrol sooner.
do_not_simplify_as: submarine force x1.3 from component percentages

entries.valid_from: first units complete 1942 autumn-end; combat-ready primarily 1943 onward per lot ledger
entries.what_changed: First-generation high-speed submerged submarine changes underwater movement from mainly evasion to deliberate firing-position correction/repositioning.

magnitude.range: 18.5-19.0 kt submerged maximum; 55-65 min full-speed endurance, center ~60 min; 42-47 s dive time

combat_meaning: Can convert aging contact reports into viable firing positions when time-to-crossing thresholds are met; e.g. 10 nmi correction ~33 min at 18 kt versus ~75 min at 8 kt.
do_not_simplify_as: available in mass during 1941-42 major battles

combat_meaning: Changes time structure from detect-attack-lost-search again to contact retention and repeated attacks.

entries.what_changed: Search evolves from one-shot sector search toward broad search, suspicious-contact revisit, fast confirmation, tracking, and later position update.

combat_meaning: Improves probability that uncertain sightings become timely actionable tracks rather than one-time observations.

entries.what_changed: Radar provides meaningful rough detection/early warning but remains a human-mediated input into plotting, optical confirmation, and fire control rather than a modern closed loop.

magnitude.range: scenario computing may improve practical detection distance about 5-15% where applicable; primary value is new all-weather/low-visibility input, not automatic accuracy

combat_meaning: Can buy warning minutes and restore contact in poor visibility; does not automatically identify ship type, solve target motion, direct CAP perfectly, or guarantee gunfire hits.

combat_meaning: More reliable/earlier effective fire, especially under nonstandard conditions, while salvo-observe-correct cycle remains.

entries.what_changed: Japanese high-grade operational cryptosystems and key/traffic discipline are sufficiently improved that US reconstruction from high-grade ciphertext cannot normally deliver operation location, exact schedule, and force composition with short-strategic timeliness/precision.

magnitude.range: near-unavailable for short-strategic exploitation of high-grade content; not mathematically unbreakable forever

combat_meaning: Historical JN-25-like high-grade content advantages must not be silently reinserted into US pre-battle knowledge.

combat_meaning: Raises schedule/intercept realization probability and can enable other tactics such as re-entry after torpedo reload.

combat_meaning: Prevents both naive Warsman-style unconditional multiplication and the opposite error of treating every improvement as disconnected minor increments.
